review:
Great Game Rockies is a Hacksaw Gaming paylines slot with a hunting theme. Hunting Season symbols trigger a Hunt where five shots are fired; any animal symbols hit become coins or traps. Animals show one to four stars, which set the minimum coin type, and traps collect the values of all coins and other traps on screen. Wilds on hit reels add a multiplier to between one and five coins or traps.

Three FS give 10 free spins with more Hunting Season symbols. Four FS give 10 spins where animals in regular wins gain a star that carries over. Five FS unlock the hidden Epic bonus, with a Hunting Season symbol on every spin. Hacksaw lists 3/5 volatility, a 5,000x max win and RTPs from 96.33% to 86.25%.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.25% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
